column1: # What the image cache decides from one 200 response, read by both test suites.
# Times are milliseconds after 1793491200000 (Sun, 01 Nov 2026 00:00:00 GMT).
# `fallback_ttl` and `stale_if_error` are the cache settings, `-` for absent
# (no fallback; the 24 h default). `headers` is `name: value` items joined by
# ` | `. `fresh` and `stale_allowed` are asked at `now`: whether the entry is
# served with no request, and whether a failed revalidation may serve it.
# The conditional columns are what a revalidation sends. A row that is not
# storable has `-` in every later column.
